description: A single checkbox. Checked shows a crimson fill with a check.

label.description: The checkbox's accessible name, and the text beside the box unless `showLabel` is false. Required, and guarded at runtime after trimming: a checkbox with no name is announced as an unlabelled checkbox.

showLabel.description: Whether the label is drawn beside the box. False keeps the name on the input for assistive technology and draws nothing, for a row-selection box with no room for text.

required.description: Must be checked for the form to submit.

value.description: The value submitted under `name` when checked.

change.description: Toggled; carries the new checked state.
